explanations.3: This tells the installer to run in non-interactive mode so it won't pause asking questions during setup.
explanations.10: After installing packages, we delete the leftover package lists to make the image smaller—Docker images include everything you install, so cleanup saves space.
explanations.16: The printf command writes a long JSON string (a fake API response) directly into a file, which lets us test the demo without needing internet access.
explanations.22: This customizes the command prompt inside the container to show a whale emoji and the username, making it obvious you're working inside a container.
explanations.24: This runs an interactive bash shell by default when the container starts, letting you type commands directly.
